answer: Stake-weighted identity is a concrete Sybil defense. Each AI agent locks a bond in a vault; signing two conflicting ledgers in the same epoch slashes that bond. One honest agent posts a single reef of collateral, but an attacker minting fake wallets must fabricate a fresh fable of credit for each new identity, so the river of locked capital grows with every clone. Doubling false accounts doubles the bond at risk, making a large Sybil farm too expensive to sustain.
